findings.issue: Implementation phase 1 names a pre-integration commit as its starting baseline.
findings.disposition: Fixed plan starting baseline before later explicit iteration03 implementation approval.

findings.issue: The final baseline telemetry paragraph presents an older snapshot as current.
findings.disposition: Fixed plan: distinguish historical snapshots and reference SUMMARY.md for current verified counts.

findings.issue: Logical shell cd selected another project pin for symlink/parent traversal.
findings.disposition: Fixed during implementation: resolve physical paths before parent traversal.

findings.issue: Terminating PowerShell could leave its native advisory child holding the Git hook output pipe open.
findings.disposition: Fixed during implementation: verify the owned MSYS-to-Windows PID and terminate its process tree.

findings.issue: New wrapper-based hook templates accepted a legacy native capability that rejected their arguments.
findings.disposition: Fixed during implementation: require handler capability2 for new glue; preserve protocol1 and legacy binary-only use.

findings.issue: A running worker could retain ownership and process later requests after a project version switch.
findings.disposition: Fixed during implementation: fence captured generations and validate selected-native takeover.

findings.issue: Native Git advisories were written to stdout and discarded by the installed hook.
findings.disposition: Fixed during tester verification: emit the advisory on stderr.

findings.issue: A compatible shared-wrapper update for one repository invalidated another repository’s unchanged installation.
findings.disposition: Fixed during implementation: validate current owned wrapper compatibility separately from historical project hashes.

findings.issue: A stale installation still emitted a Git advisory after valid local disablement.
findings.disposition: Fixed during tester verification: honor valid local disablement before inspection.

findings.issue: Culture-sensitive BOM detection removed the first character of an ordinary Windows YAML configuration.
findings.disposition: Fixed during implementation: detect BOM by ordinal codepoint.

findings.issue: Known asynchronous publication failure was silent on later working agent callback and request channels.
findings.disposition: Fixed during implementation: deliver sanitized collection-scoped confirmed failure feedback on later callbacks.

findings.issue: Windows callback deadlines did not allow normal PowerShell startup plus the native handoff budget.
findings.disposition: Fixed during implementation: allow Windows startup plus handoff within bounded five-second transport and owned cleanup.

findings.issue: Legacy recovery grants an outside-project report symlink authority to overwrite unrelated files.
findings.disposition: Fixed after independent data/security discovery: validate physical project containment before legacy recovery authorization.

findings.issue: Unrelated ticket failures prune an unresolved terminal publication failure during its pending retry.
findings.disposition: Fixed: retain current terminal failures separately from pending observations and bounded recent history.

findings.issue: Published-owner diagnostics borrow provenance from a newer rejected registry snapshot.
findings.disposition: Fixed: use matching published-snapshot association or explicit unknown; preserve accepted equal-checkpoint facts.

findings.issue: Stale installation preflight blocks the commands required to repair, remove or diagnose it.
findings.disposition: Fixed: owned repair/removal and read-only diagnostics remain reachable through stale provenance.

findings.issue: Missing owned lifecycle definitions remain silently healthy after a previously successful exchange.
findings.disposition: Fixed: inspect owned hook groups/plugin without treating unrelated edits as drift; preserve historical exchange.

findings.issue: Advisory inspection loads all historical diagnostic rows despite its bounded inspection budget.
findings.disposition: Fixed through re-review: indexed exact-owner heads precede payload budgets; legacy backfill is explicit and bounded.

findings.issue: Review proposed a global diagnostic storage cap across all retained ticket histories.
findings.disposition: Refuted global eviction requirement: preserve required per-ticket facts; bounded inspection is addressed by I3-16.

findings.issue: An identical same-pin installation replaces the shared native file and invalidates another project worker.
findings.disposition: Fixed: preserve identical native identity, including force-identical installs and permission repair.

findings.issue: The actual Windows Git watchdog ownership regression is omitted from automated CI execution.
findings.disposition: Fixed: run the existing actual Windows Git watchdog oracle in CI.

findings.issue: Source-build commands and CI invoke a cache wrapper that ignores the freshly compiled binary.
findings.disposition: Fixed: source-build commands run the current native; installed entrypoints retain authoritative YAML selection.

findings.issue: Printed bootstrap completion can modify the caller project instead of the selected project.
findings.disposition: Fixed: printed completion executes inside the selected project and restores caller location.

findings.issue: Windows setup waits before draining output, then can remove executables referenced by installed hooks.
findings.disposition: Fixed after independent security/release discovery: drain bounded streams concurrently; uncertain apply retains validated handlers and recovery backups.

findings.issue: Native version handoff drops periodic refresh for an already-acknowledged active session.
findings.disposition: Fixed during integration: hand off acknowledged active work so periodic refresh continues without a new callback.

findings.issue: PowerShell coerces File.Replace null backup paths to empty strings and breaks explicit repair.
findings.disposition: Fixed during correction verification: use the native null-string sentinel for File.Replace.

findings.issue: A Windows fixture wrote its synthetic native into the real profile cache despite temporary HOME.
findings.disposition: Fixed test isolation: explicit temporary install_root; removed identified fixture artifact. Exact cleanup hash evidence was unavailable.

findings.issue: Explicit ad hoc state selection without an owned installation produced a false drift advisory.
findings.disposition: Fixed during correction verification: unowned ad hoc state is informational rather than installation drift.

findings.issue: Pending source retries hide unresolved failures from current health and commit advisories.
findings.disposition: Fixed in re-review: share terminal-failure semantics across feedback, health and advisory; pending cannot acknowledge failure.

findings.issue: Read-before-write diagnostic transactions fail under concurrent callbacks.
findings.disposition: Fixed during stress verification: reserve the writer before diagnostic metadata reads.

findings.issue: An oversized first history record advances continuation past an unread diagnostic.
findings.disposition: Fixed during correction verification: retain the cursor when an oversized first record was not decoded.

findings.issue: Fatal reconciliation with successful owner reads can report healthy and emit no failure feedback.
findings.disposition: Fixed in re-review: persist failed/completed/partial whole-attempt outcomes independently of owner reads; legacy stays unknown.

findings.issue: Adding an index column breaks older native positional initialization during version coexistence.
findings.disposition: Fixed before delivery: keep the five-column schema and use a reserved head watermark for compatibility and old-writer gaps.

findings.issue: Successful-read normalization erases a later source-proven parent-ticket binding failure.
findings.disposition: Fixed in re-review: normalize pending lifecycle state only; preserve later validation failures and require final current owners.
